tables.name: Tavern Encounters
tables.description: A little trouble, mystery, or unexpected company in the local tavern.

rows.result: A hooded stranger quietly pays for the party's drinks.
Two merchants argue loudly over a missing shipment.
A bard sings a song that mentions one of the characters by name.
Someone slips a sealed letter under the party's table.
A heavily armored knight asks for directions to a ruined temple.
The innkeeper discovers a strange symbol burned into the bar.
A nervous traveler claims to have seen a dragon nearby.
A local gambler challenges a character to a game of chance.
The tavern lights flicker, although there is no wind.
A small creature steals food and vanishes through a hole in the wall.
A messenger arrives with news of a missing caravan.
An old adventurer offers to trade a map for a favor.
